The features needed to even attract me are below

  • Day 1 Backwards compatibility to the largest Nintendo catalog (including portable games) No WiiU supporter would give up their already "limited" catalog

  • Previous Controller integration on top of a new gaming controller If all the Wii stuff turns to scrap overnight you better believe people will just flock to the used market for their Nintendo fix

I don't think hardware or tablets are the cause of the Wii U's sales slump. The problem is the lack of good mid budget games. It seems like in the console world these days, everything has to be AAA or shovelware with nothing in between. The reason why the handheld market had so many great games was because developers were pumping out lots of great games on a lower budget with more focus on gameplay than graphics. Nintendo is so afraid of cutting into it's 3DS sales that they discourage bringing any beloved DS franchises to the Wii U. If Ninty wants to live, they need to start attracting smaller third parties to make smaller games like Meteos and Advance Wars again and flesh out the Wii U library.

Whatever they do with the next console, I just hope they do away with controller gimmicks. I don't want waggle sticks, I don't want to use a stylus, and I for damn sure don't want to hold a giant uncomfortable slab of plastic. Let's not overthink this -- all Nintendo needs to do is stick with a traditional controller, beef up the hardware to near PS4/X1 levels, and concentrate on what they've always done: making great games out of great IPs. Overhauling their atrocious Network ID system wouldn't hurt either...
